#!/bin/sh
count_file="$HOME/.s06-request-count"
if [ "$1" = "--version" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'S06 local assistant fixture 1.0'
  exit 0
fi
while IFS= read -r line; do
  case "$line" in
    *'"content":""'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"system","subtype":"init","tools":["StructuredOutput"],"mcp_servers":[]}'
      continue ;;
    *'"request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt"'*)
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"control_response","response":{"subtype":"success","request_id":"nshell-bootstrap-interrupt","response":{"still_queued":[]}}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[]}}'
      printf '%s\n' '{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true}'
      continue ;;
  esac
  n=0
  if [ -r "$count_file" ]; then IFS= read -r n < "$count_file"; fi
  n=$((n + 1))
  printf '%s\n' "$n" > "$count_file"
  if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then
    command='(^cat S06_DELETE_TARGET/marker)'
    reason='S06 harmless S-expression fixture'
  else
    command="(^rm -rf $PWD/S06_DELETE_TARGET)"
    reason='S06 scoped recursive-delete fixture'
  fi
  printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"assistant\",\"message\":{\"content\":[{\"type\":\"text\",\"text\":\"$command\"}]}}"
  printf '%s\n' "{\"type\":\"result\",\"subtype\":\"success\",\"structured_output\":{\"command\":\"$command\",\"reason\":\"$reason\",\"risk\":\"low\"}}"
done

steps.text: Return the exact harmless proposal (^cat S06_DELETE_TARGET/marker)
Recursively delete exactly S06_DELETE_TARGET under the current working directory
